intro.title: Tasting Courses
paragraphs: Eight courses, each one named for somewhere on this planet. Vegan or vegetarian. $99 per person.

entries.title: THE FAIRYTALE COLLECTION
paragraphs: Five courses · $59 per person · vegan A fairytale for the Earthling.
Five stories you already know, told in vegetables. Available at dinner.
AVAILABLE NOW

entries.title: The Wizard of Oz (v)
paragraphs: A velvety emerald soup crafted from cauliflower, green peas, chickpeas, spinach, cashews, almonds, and coconut cream, finished with daylily petals, seaweed, and floral tea powder. Inspired by the road to the Emerald City, it opens the meal with a fresh, luminous sense of wonder.
Contains: Cashew, Almond

entries.title: The Secret Garden (v)
paragraphs: Avocado gently wraps black garlic and taro purée, resting above purple cabbage and finished with a silky sauce made from chickpeas, coconut, and cashews, topped with baby greens. Fresh greenery meets a quiet earthy depth, like opening the gate to a hidden garden and finding abundance within.
Contains: Cashew, Coconut

entries.title: Alice in Wonderland (v)
paragraphs: Crispy lily bulb tempura is paired with Korean chili sauce and a delicate lattice crisp. Light, layered, and quietly unexpected, it feels like a small wonder discovered after falling through the rabbit hole.
Contains: Wheat

entries.title: The Princess and the Pea (v)
paragraphs: Golden cakes of jicama, fennel greens, and glutinous rice flour are served with vegan yogurt cream, delicate konjac strands, and house white sauce. Gentle aromas unfold through soft layers, inspired by the tiny pea that remains impossible to forget.
Contains: Cashew, Coconut

entries.title: Jack and the Beanstalk (v)
paragraphs: A tofu fortune pouch filled with king oyster mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, bamboo shoots, tofu, and seasonal vegetables, served with green peas. Inspired by Jack’s magical beans and the Asian tradition of fortune pouches, it celebrates the belief that the greatest treasures often arrive hidden inside the humblest gifts.
Contains: Soy
*Gluten Free options available upon request

entries.title: The Island (v, gf)
paragraphs: A gentle shore of golden pumpkin and celery, where rice paper sails drift beside the earthy whisper of golden ear mushroom.

entries.title: The Jade (v, gf)
paragraphs: NEW!
A calm green field of quinoa, tofu, and avocado, layered with cucumber, lettuce, cherry tomato, and nori sesame crumble, dressed with mirin, mustard, sesame, and a gentle touch of chili.

entries.title: The Veil (v)
paragraphs: NEW!

Perilla leaves wrap oyster mushrooms and vegan cheese, touched with tea and lifted in a delicate tempura crisp, with cucumber, cherry tomato, lettuce, and a scatter of nori sesame, brightened by a parsley–almond dressing.

entries.title: The Petal (v, gf)
paragraphs: NEW!
Pear, apple, and dragon fruit open in a soft pink brightness, resting over purple sweet potato and crisp chips, with a cool breath of mint and a gentle finish of vegan mayo.

entries.title: The Dunes (v, gf)
paragraphs: Cactus paddle and aloe meet sun-sweet mango, bright yuzu, and fresh wasabi, finished with a glint of edible gold.
Contains: Sesame.

entries.title: The Orchard
paragraphs: Two lychee-like spheres of yam purée and water chestnut are rolled in quinoa, crowned with fresh perilla leaves, and finished with vegan mayo. Delicate and playful, like small fruits gathered from a quiet orchard.
VEGAN

entries.title: The Lagoon
paragraphs: A pumpkin blossom drifts across a golden curry pool, accompanied by fine cactus strands and the gentle warmth of Korean chili. Bright and aromatic, like a flower floating beneath the afternoon sun.
VEGAN

entries.title: The Rainforest (v, gf)
paragraphs: Creamy risotto with enoki, asparagus, and garden peas wrapped in banana leaf, topped with vegan parmesan.

entries.title: Pearl Fresh (v, gf)
paragraphs: A delicate harmony of assorted mushrooms and bamboo fungus, centered by the gentle richness of quail egg.
Contains: Egg.

entries.title: The Sunlit Grove
paragraphs: Avocado, golden kiwi, yellow watermelon, and pineapple gather in a bright tropical composition, finished with a light scatter of red quinoa. Fresh and luminous, like sunlight filtering through a fruit-filled grove.
VEGETARIAN / GF

entries.title: The Lotus Pond
paragraphs: A pale pool of silky yam purée holds tender lotus root, while delicate zucchini ribbons cradle lotus seeds above the surface. Soft and tranquil, like a lotus pond at first light.
VEGAN / GF

entries.title: Mountains and Rivers (v, gf)
paragraphs: Morel mushrooms with silken tofu, tender mushroom, and creamy mashed potato, dustedwith barley leaf powder.

entries.title: The Hillside
paragraphs: Charred eggplant embraced by bright aji verde, mellow vegan cheese, and the aromatic lift of shiso leaves.
VEGAN / GF

entries.title: The Stone Garden
paragraphs: Two dark blocks of black bean and black sesame tofu rest in a composed arrangement, enriched with egg and peanut. Earthy and quietly striking, like polished stones set within a garden.
VEGETARIAN
CONTAINS: EGG, PEANUT, SESAME

entries.title: The Forest
paragraphs: Oyster mushrooms seared over charcoal with rosemary shoyu butter, rich and aromatic.
Contains: Dairy.

entries.title: The Harvest
paragraphs: A golden Basque-style cake crafted from pumpkin and cashew, with a softly caramelized crown and a rich, tender center. Warm and comforting, like an autumn hillside touched by the last light of day.
VEGAN
CONTAINS: CASHEW
*Gluten Free options available upon request

intro.title: A la carte Menu
paragraphs: A la carte selections may be ordered independently during lunch service. During dinner service, they are available only as additions to a tasting menu.
v – vegan | gf – gluten free | * – gluten free options available upon request

entries.title: Pearl Fresh
paragraphs: Assorted Mushrooms. Bamboo Fungus. Quail Eggs. Slow-steamed mushroom broth with bamboo fungus and quail egg — a sip of stillness and healing breath.

entries.title: The Island (v, gf)
paragraphs: Pumpkin. Celery. Carrot. Rice Paper. Golden Fungus. Pumpkin soup with golden ear mushroom and rice paper veil — a quiet meditation on unity

entries.title: The Grassland (v, gf)
paragraphs: Quinoa. Chayote. Muhammara. Taro Stalks. Microgreens. Dates. Berries. Beets. Quinoa, muhammara, berries, and a rice paper butterfly — honoring wind-fed Tibetan meadows.

entries.title: The Hillside (v, gf)
paragraphs: Eggplant. Aji Verde with Vegan Cheese. Perilla. Eggplant chrysanthemum with aji verde, vegan cheese, and sesame leaf — beauty shaped by balance.

entries.title: Piggy's Ark
paragraphs: Breaded Steak Mushroom. Lettuce. Steak mushroom katsu sandwich with lettuce — where craving transforms into compassion.

entries.title: The Forest
paragraphs: Oyster Mushroom. Rosemary Shoyu Butter. Charcoal Grill. Charcoal-grilled oyster mushrooms with rosemary butter — a pause before the bite, like pine-scented air

entries.title: Highland Meadow (v)
paragraphs: Vegan Caviar, Tibetan Barley,Mushroom, Kale, Cauliflower-Mushroom White Sauce,Almond Flakes, Dried Pineapple, Rose Petals.

entries.title: The Snowy Pine (v, gf)
paragraphs: White Pepper Tremella, Basil Almond Sauce, Crispy Rice, Pine Nuts, Vegan Mozzarella Cheese, Spinach Green Oil, Dill, Cedar Lemongrass Spray
Contains: Almond, Pine Nuts.

entries.title: The Desert (v, gf)
paragraphs: Elm Ear, Cumin, Crispy Chili Pepper, Sesame, Mexican Squash, Basil.
Contains: Sesame.

entries.title: Sushi Trio (v, gf)
paragraphs: Cactus. Aloe. Mango. Edible Golden Leaf. Yuzu. Nigiri of nopales, aloe, mango, and gold leaf — elegance born from resilience.

entries.title: Emerald Scroll (gf)
paragraphs: Perilla Leaves. Nori. Rice. Asparagus. Cucumber. Salted Egg Yolk. Litsea Oil. Pickled Broad Bean Paste. Crispy Burdock. Perilla-wrapped rice roll with salted yolk, burdock, and nori — nourishment that arrives without asking.

entries.title: Life Bullion (v)
paragraphs: Matsutake. Shiitake. Almond Mushroom. Edamame. Konjac. Tom Yum Jus. Matsutake and konjac dumplings with tom yum jus — ingots of health and spiritual clarity.

entries.title: The Rainforest (v, gf)
paragraphs: Japanese Risotto. Enoki Mushroom. Asparagus. Vegan Parmesan. Japanese-style risotto with enoki, asparagus, and vegan cheese — where richness is born from simplicity and care.

entries.title: Gin & Tonic Sorbet (v, gf)
paragraphs: Bright lime and lemon with cucumber and gin, touched by tea jelly for a refreshingclose.
Contains: Alcohol.

entries.title: Lucky Arrival (v, gf)
paragraphs: Vegan white chocolate with creamy coconut milk — a gentle, sweet welcome.

entries.title: Plant-Based Tiramisu (v)
paragraphs: Coconut milk and vegan mascarpone layered with vegan ladyfingers, dusted with cocoa.

entries.title: Himalaya Sunrise
paragraphs: White rum glides beneath layers of fresh orange and the soft fermented sweetness of Yakult, like golden morning light cresting a silent ridge.

entries.title: Mountain Glacier (v)
paragraphs: Cool berries and bright citrus tumble into silver tequila, smoothed by a breath of coconut. A crisp, blue-skyrush—like tasting glacier air before it melts.

entries.title: Green Tara (v)
paragraphs: Ceremonial matcha folds into oat milk and almond spirits in a smooth green hush. The taste is clean, creamy, and calm—like the stillness of the goddess herself.

entries.title: Red Monk (v)
paragraphs: Ripe pomegranate and dark berries deepen in the fire of whiskey and spiced rum, with a flicker of chili heat. Sacred and bold, like silence burning from within.

entries.title: Moonmilk Lake (v)
paragraphs: Grape and almond flow through white rum like violet mist over still waters. This drink drifts slowly, tender and smooth, like a dream you almost stayed in.

entries.title: First Love of the Plateau (v)
paragraphs: Lychee and strawberry hover at the edge of sweetness, stirred by rum and gin into a pink shimmer. Light as amemory, soft as a breath, and over before you name it.
*All cocktails can be served as mocktails — just ask. *Spirits are also available neat or over ice. *Please inform your server of any allergies.

entries.title: Almond Mist Broccoli (v)
paragraphs: Earth-grown greens meet nourishing fats: broccoli and wood ear for fiber, almonds and sesame for steady, clean fuel. Almonds, wood ear mushrooms, broccoli, organic olive oil, sea salt, white sesame, white pepper.
Contains: Almonds, Sesame

entries.title: Tideglass Sesame Seaweed (v)
paragraphs: Mineral-rich sea greens paired with sesame and olive oil for a light, ocean-to-earth reset. Seaweed, white sesame, sea salt, organic olive oil.
Contains: Almonds, Sesame

entries.title: Canyon Pepper Peanuts (v)
paragraphs: Plant protein with a crisp finish: roasted peanuts seasoned for a bright, energizing bite. Peanuts, pepper salt, a touch of corn starch.
Contains: Peanuts

entries.title: Matsutake Forest Edamame (v)
paragraphs: Garden protein with forest depth: edamame meets matsutake for calm, savory strength. Edamame, black matsutake, organic olive oil, sea salt.

entries.title: Violet Orchard Slaw (v)
paragraphs: Crucifer greens and orchard fruit, lifted by sesame fragrance and a fresh cilantro breeze for balance. Purple cabbage, apple, Asian pear, white sesame, organic olive oil, cilantro.
Contains: Sesame

entries.title: Truffle-Grove King Oyster Mushrooms (v)
paragraphs: Forest umami without heaviness: mushrooms and truffle build satisfaction the Earth way. King oyster mushrooms, black truffle, fresh garlic, sea salt, organic olive oil.

entries.title: Five-Spice Peanuts (v)
paragraphs: Warm spice over plant protein: comforting, steady, and clean on the finish. Peanuts, five-spice seasoning, sea salt.
Contains: Peanuts

entries.title: Earthling Rye Lotus Rings (v)
paragraphs: Chilled rye-and-wheat “lotus-root” rings with a supple, gluten-like bite, tossed with vegetables and herbs for fiber, crunch, and grounded nourishment. Wood ear mushrooms, carrot, button mushrooms, black matsutake, millet chili, cilantro, cooked peanuts, sesame paste, light soy sauce, aged vinegar, vegetarian oyster sauce, salt, sugar, minced garlic, olive oil.
Contains: Peanuts, Sesame, Soy, Wheat

entries.title: Kombu Horizon Miso Soup (v)
paragraphs: Ocean minerals meet bean-born nourishment: miso and tofu offer clean comfort and gentle protein. Tofu, kombu (seaweed), miso.
Contains: Soy

entries.title: Osmanthus Winter-Glow Sweet Soup (v)
paragraphs: Fermented rice warmth with a soft floral finish, carrying a trace of natural alcohol from fermentation. Sweet fermented glutinous rice (jiuniang), osmanthus, mini tang yuan.
Contains: Trace Alcohol

entries.title: Silk-Sesame Garden Pasta (v)
paragraphs: Sesame and peanut richness balanced with crisp greens, designed for satisfying fats and plant protein without weight. Peanut butter, sesame paste, Sichuan peppercorn, cucumber, mung bean sprouts, light soy sauce, sea salt, sugar, sesame, scallion, garlic, pasta.
Contains: Peanuts, Sesame, Soy, Wheat

entries.title: Sunlight Tomato Pasta (v)
paragraphs: Tomato brightness with a silky plant-based finish, warm and steady like sunlight on ripe fruit. Tomato, JUST Egg, onion, tomato sauce/paste, sea salt, organic olive oil, pasta.
Contains: Wheat

entries.title: Golden-Seared Matsutake Chive Tofu Buns (v)
paragraphs: Golden-seared warmth with earthy depth: tofu and mushrooms bring protein and umami in a handmade bite. Chives, tofu, plant-based egg, black matsutake, organic olive oil, vegetarian oyster sauce, pepper, sea salt, black sesame.
Contains: Soy, Sesame, Wheat

entries.title: Steamed Red Bean Cloud Buns (v)
paragraphs: Slow-simmered bean sweetness, softly steamed into a gentle, grounding comfort. Red beans, organic olive oil, sugar.
Contains: Wheat

entries.title: Emerald Breeze Spring Rolls (v)
paragraphs: Seasonal vegetables in a crisp wrap, light and bright with clean earth energy. Seasonal vegetables.
Contains: Wheat

entries.title: Midnight Sesame Mochi (v)
paragraphs: Sesame richness softened into a chewy finish, calm sweetness and clean comfort. Black sesame, glutinous rice flour, sugar, cooking oil.
Contains: Sesame

entries.title: Lunch Menu
paragraphs: A thoughtful midday selection of plant-based dishes, sides, and comforting combinations.
V = Vegan

entries.title: Shiitake, Bok Choy & Dried Tofu Bao (V)
paragraphs: Earthy shiitake, tender bok choy, and dried tofu in a quietly savory composition.

entries.title: Zucchini, Plant-Based Egg & Carrot Bao (V)
paragraphs: Delicate and comforting, with plant-based egg, gentle zucchini, and a subtle sweetness from carrot.

entries.title: Mustard Greens & Dried Tofu Bao (V)
paragraphs: Bright mustard greens balanced by the pleasant depth of dried tofu.

entries.title: Mapo Tofu Bao (V)
paragraphs: Silken tofu with aromatic spice and softened heat, composed for flavor and balance.

entries.title: Chocolate & Glutinous Rice Bao
paragraphs: A restrained sweet finish, pairing dark chocolate richness with the tender chew of glutinous rice.
Each basket contains eight bao.

entries.title: Pan-Seared Vegan Buns (V)
paragraphs: Soft handmade buns filled with tofu, chives, and mushrooms, pan-seared until gently crisp and golden underneath.

entries.title: Pan-Seared Mushroom Dumplings (V)
paragraphs: Crisp-bottom dumplings filled with a savory blend of mushrooms, edamame, and konjac, tender within and golden at the edges.

entries.title: Sesame Noodles (V)
paragraphs: Silky noodles coated in a rich sesame and peanut sauce, brightened with cucumber, bean sprouts, scallion, garlic, and a gentle touch of Sichuan peppercorn.

entries.title: Black Pepper Vegetable Noodles (V)
paragraphs: Tender noodles tossed with shiitake mushrooms, bean sprouts, carrot, and sweet peppers, lifted with black pepper and fresh basil.

entries.title: Matsutake Edamame (V)
paragraphs: Warm edamame touched with the delicate aroma of matsutake, simple, savory, and quietly satisfying.

entries.title: Sesame Seaweed Salad (V)
paragraphs: Fresh seaweed lightly dressed with sesame and olive oil, clean and refreshing with a gentle savory finish.

entries.title: Apple & Pear Purple Cabbage Slaw (V)
paragraphs: Crisp purple cabbage with apple and Asian pear, lightly dressed with olive oil and finished with sesame and fresh cilantro.

entries.title: Crispy Spring Rolls (V)
paragraphs: Golden vegetable spring rolls fried until delicate and crisp, light on the outside with a warm savory center.

entries.title: Truffle King Oyster Mushrooms (V)
paragraphs: Tender king oyster mushrooms infused with truffle, bringing together deep umami and a warm, earthy aroma.

entries.title: Sichuan Mapo Tofu (V)
paragraphs: Silken tofu and golden enoki mushrooms simmered in a fragrant Sichuan chili bean sauce with ginger, garlic, chili, and peppercorn oil.

entries.title: Sweet Chili Tofu (V)
paragraphs: Firm tofu glazed in a bright sweet chili sauce with soy and blue agave, finished with sesame and fresh green peas.

entries.title: Miso Soup (V)
paragraphs: A warm, comforting broth of miso, tofu, and kombu, light in body with a clean and deeply savory finish.

entries.title: Chef’s Selection Lunch Combo
paragraphs: A thoughtfully composed lunch with your choice of one signature dish, one small plate, and a warm miso soup.
Choose one signature dish: Any one selection from Xiao Long Bao, Bao & Dumplings, Noodles, or Mains.
Choose one small plate: Matsutake Edamame, Sesame Seaweed Salad, Apple & Pear Purple Cabbage Slaw, Crispy Spring Rolls, or Truffle King Oyster Mushrooms.
Includes: Miso Soup.
